## Interval fields

A genomic interval has sequence name, start, end, strand, and metadata. BED is 0-based half-open; GFF/GTF are 1-based closed. Mixing coordinate systems silently creates off-by-one errors.

## R tools

Use `GenomicRanges`, `IRanges`, and `rtracklayer` for interval operations:

```r
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
peaks <- import("peaks.narrowPeak", format = "BED")
genes <- import("annotation.gff3")
```

## Interpretation

Nearest genes and promoter overlaps are model choices. They identify candidates, not confirmed mechanisms.
